description_en: Modifies the maintenance window or description of an ApsaraDB for SelectDB instance
description_zh: 修改指定云数据库SelectDB版实例的运维时间或备注信息
kebab_example: aliyun selectdb modify-db-instance-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id selectdb-cn-7213cjv0000 --instance-attribute-type DBInstanceDescription --value testdb01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDBInstanceAttribute

parameters.description_en: The region ID of the instance.
parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.description_en:
The instance parameter to be modified. Valid values:

- **MaintainTime**: Modify the maintenance window of the instance in the hh:mm-hh:mm format.

- **DBInstanceDescription**: Modify the description of the instance.
parameters.description_zh:
修改项，取值说明：

- **MaintainTime**：修改运维时间，格式为hh:mm-hh:mm。

- **DBInstanceDescription**：修改实例备注。

parameters.name: instance_attribute_type

parameters.description_en:
The new value of the instance parameter to be modified. Examples:

- If InstanceAttributeType is set to MaintainTime, you can set Value to 00:00-06:00.

- If InstanceAttributeType is set to DBInstanceDescription, you can set Value to testdb.
parameters.description_zh:
修改内容。取值说明：

- 当InstanceAttributeType为MaintainTime时，您可以取值为00:00-06:00。

- 当InstanceAttributeType为DBInstanceDescription时，您可以取值为testdb。
